title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer. We plan 20000 pieces per year from 1 January 2027 and propose a multi-year agreement of 24 or 36 months. Your team noted that only multi-year volume agreements change prices on standard items. Our forecast fc:360020@2026-09 records a 4.2% increase in demand for this part, so the agreement has growth potential. The attached term sheets set out three complete packages, each at 20000 pieces per year: 24 months at 30 days, 24 months at 60 days, and 36 months at 30 days. Please let us know which package works best for you. Could you also offer a cheaper equivalent variant of the 6306-2Z C3 if you have one?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
Here is the background.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month agreement and can offer €4.88 per unit with 30-day payment terms.
Regarding your question about a cheaper equivalent variant, our technical team will provide you with the available options.
We cannot accommodate the significant price reduction you requested, as our pricing reflects the current cost environment.
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 renewal - 36-month packages and pricing review
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the revised offer. We can commit to 20000 pieces per year for 36 months, which is the multi-year volume agreement your team described as the basis for price changes.

Your scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 85.0%.

The same scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 records 302 ppm, above your standard quality commitment.

The attached term sheets offer three complete 36-month packages at 20000 pieces per year, with payment terms of 30, 60 or 90 days.

Your owner kindly offered in June to walk us through your calculation. Could you arrange an authorised pricing review with him? We would also welcome details of any cheaper equivalent variant.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 renewal - 36-month packages and pricing review
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We value you as a customer and appreciate your proposal for a 36-month agreement and can offer €4.88 per unit with 30-day payment terms. Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative, we have an option at a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our quote remains valid for 7 days.

As to the quality record data you cited, that does not change our position. We have reviewed the quality record you cited; however, this does not change our pricing. A pricing review with our owner cannot be arranged, and our technical team will address your request for equivalent variants separately. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Our current defect rate for you is about 150 ppm. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
